services.desc: Season runs from May 13 - October 31, 2026 (weather dependent) THERE IS CONSTRUCTION ON HIGHWAY 93 IN FRONT OF THE RANCH. PLEASE ALLOW AN ADDITIONAL 30 MINUTES TO ARRIVE ON TIME! From our home at the base of Spencer Mountain, we offer outstanding horseback riding in the mountainous Montana terrain surrounding the ranch. Our knowledgeable wranglers, the assorted terrain, and our large herd of good mountain horses make riding at the Bar W exceptional. Your trail ride adventure begins when we match you with a suitable horse, followed by an orientation designed to help you feel confident on your horse.
